title: overFunctor exact ofUniverses
statement:
For a ring sheaf R on a site (C,J), restriction of module sheaves to C/U preserves finite limits and finite colimits, assuming the abelian sheafification and local-bijectivity comparisons on the site and slice. Object and morphism universes are independent.

Precise quantified statement:
theorem overFunctor_exact_ofUniverses
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{r}) (U : C)
    [HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}]
    [(J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v r}] :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (overFunctor.{max u v r} R U) ∧
      PreservesFiniteColimits (overFunctor.{max u v r} R U)

Notions used: [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pur-localized-ringed-site].

source.place: Tags 08G7, 08FX, 08FN, 08G0; Modules on Sites Tags 03DJ, 04IX and 08FD.

proof.text: Compare restriction with abelian sheaf restriction under the faithful forgetful functors. Presheaf evaluation proves finite-limit preservation. The cocontinuous sheaf adjunction proves finite-colimit preservation. Forgetting modules reflects the universal properties.
